title: Plus Size Sleeveless V-Neck Pleated A-Line Formal Evening Dress
descriptionHtml:
Embrace elegance in our Plus Size Sleeveless V-Neck Pleated A-Line Formal Evening Dress. The V-neckline and sleeveless design create a flattering and sophisticated look. With pleated details enhancing the A-line silhouette, this dress ensures a comfortable and stylish fit for formal occasions. Celebrate your curves with confidence in this timeless and chic evening gown.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Floor Length.


Sleeve Style: Sleeveless.


Closure: It is concealed a zipper up the back.


Undergarments: It is padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises polyester.


Stretch: Fabric is high stretch.
